claim: The :Devata-only range on ASSERTION_AGENT and ASSERTION_TARGET, and the absence of any relationship type for the other three declared roles, make most of a semantic-role layer unrepresentable.
side_one_reading: The layer already in the graph hit this wall and worked around it in the worst possible way. Its 2,406 MORPHOLOGY_RULE assertions carry 1,364 patients, 366 instruments, 356 beneficiaries and 225 locations as opaque STRING PROPERTIES on the assertion node, and 0 edges for any of them, because there is no relationship type that could hold them and ASSERTION_TARGET would have required the filler to be a deity. 2,311 role fillers are therefore present in the data and reachable by no traversal. That is not a data gap; it is the schema telling a pipeline to write prose.

layer_one_no_relationship_type_exists_fo.note: BENEFICIARY, INSTRUMENT and LOCATION are declared roles in data/registry/action_predicates.yaml and appear in the argument_frame of GRANTS, SLAYS, POURS, ESTABLISHES, CREATES, CARRIES, OFFERS, SPEAKS, MOVES_TO, FLOWS, SHINES and DWELLS. The schema has no relationship type for any of them, whatever the endpoint. SOURCE and GOAL are this agent's proposals and are counted apart.

what_a_wider_range_would_immediately_rea.note: Every entity key this artifact references was resolved against the live graph. None is invented; all 118 already exist. The endpoints a widened range would need are already in the database.

the_class_the_range_cannot_express_at_al.reading: These are the first- and second-person participants: the worshipper and the addressed god. 'Grant to us' has a recipient and it is not a deity. A role layer whose endpoints are deities can say that a god acts, and never that a god acts FOR SOMEONE, which is most of what the Samhitas say.

proposed_additive_extension.principle: Additive only. No existing relationship type changes name, direction or range; no existing edge is rewritten. The current 4,865 assertions and their 5,973 role and predicate edges keep working unchanged.

one_new_label.label: :RoleFiller
one_new_label.why: The alternative is widening ASSERTION_AGENT's range to a union of Devata, Concept, DomainEntity and something to hold a pronoun, which leaves the range open-ended and unenforceable -- and an unenforceable range is how the attribution axis in this project came to have three disagreeing writers. One reified node per filler keeps the range closed at a single label and carries the evidence the role rests on, including the surface and case that make it auditable.

new_relationship_types.note: one per filler. The role is a property of the node, so adding SOURCE, GOAL or any later role needs no schema change and no migration.

present only where the filler resolved: 4138 deity and 5681 concept fillers today. The remaining 41412 carry surface and lemma and no entity, which records an unresolved reference rather than dropping the role.

new_properties_on_SemanticAssertion.why: defect QA-3. Without it a prohibition reads as a command: 'ma apah ma osadhih himsih' becomes a requested SLAYS with the plants as PATIENT. 2,061 assertions in this artifact sit in the scope of a negation or prohibition particle and are currently only flagged in a caution string.

so the five instruments are never summed. The existing derivation property already carries MORPHOLOGY_RULE and MODEL_EXTRACTION; the three new values must not be folded into the first, and no product surface may add them.

what_this_does_not_propose: Changing the range of ASSERTION_AGENT or ASSERTION_TARGET. They stay Devata-only and keep their edges, so a consumer that wants only deity-to-deity events keeps working.
Deleting the assertion node's patient / instrument / beneficiary / location string properties. They are the record of what the earlier pipeline could not express, and they are evidence.
Any change to the closed predicate vocabulary. 41 ActionPredicate nodes, untouched.
